statements.chinese: 要不你跟我一起来？

statements.english: I don't know , it's such a long trip
statements.chinese: 我不知道，这趟旅程太漫长了。

statements.english: That would be great
statements.chinese: 那太好了。

statements.english: We could talk and play games
statements.chinese: 我们可以聊天和玩游戏。

statements.english: This could be our chance to , like , renew our friendship
statements.chinese: 这或许是我们重拾友谊的好机会。

statements.english: Are you asking me to have a " frienaissance "?
statements.chinese: 你是在建议我们来场“友情复兴”吗？

statements.english: Sure ?
statements.chinese: 确定吗？

statements.english: All right . Although , l don't think we need one , baby
statements.chinese: 好吧。不过，宝贝，我觉得我们不需要这个。

statements.english: l never stopped loving you
statements.chinese: 我从未停止爱你。

statements.english: So has anybody talked to Dr. and Mrs. Geller yet ?
statements.chinese: 那么有人和Geller博士及夫人谈过了吗？

has.definition: have（第三人称单数现在时）: 有

statements.english: They left me a message . They'll be here in any minute
statements.chinese: 他们给我留了消息。他们随时会到。

statements.english: Where is the waitress ? l'm starving
statements.chinese: 服务员在哪？我快饿死了。

starving.definition: starve（现在分词）: 饿得要死

statements.english: lt's a buffet , man
statements.chinese: 这是自助餐，老兄。

statements.english: Here's where l win all my money back !
statements.chinese: 这就是我赢回所有钱的地方！

statements.english: l gotta talk to you
statements.chinese: 我得和你谈谈。

statements.english: Sure
statements.chinese: 当然。

statements.english: What's up ?
statements.chinese: 最近怎么样？

statements.english: Monica and l almost got married last night
statements.chinese: Monica和我昨晚差点就结婚了。

statements.english: My God !
statements.chinese: 天啊！

statements.english: That's huge !
statements.chinese: 这太惊人了！

statements.english: Wait a minute . Why wasn't l invited ?
statements.chinese: 等一下。为什么没人邀请我？

statements.english: And who was gonna be your best man ?
statements.chinese: 那么谁会是你的伴郎呢？

was.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去时

statements.english: Don't say Ross . Do not say Ross
statements.chinese: 别说Ross。千万别说Ross。

statements.english: Look , I just don't think Monica and I get ready to get married yet !
statements.chinese: 听着，我只是觉得Monica和我还没准备好结婚！

statements.english: You know , l love her and everything ...
statements.chinese: 你知道的，我爱她，爱她的一切……

statements.english: ... but seeing Ross and Rachel come out of that chapel ..
statements.chinese: ...但看到Ross和Rachel从那间小教堂走出来...

statements.english: ... was like a wake- up call
statements.chinese: 就像是一记警钟

statements.english: that Monica and l are moving so fast , you know
statements.chinese: Monica和我进展得太快了，你知道的。

are.definition: are（现在时复数）: 构成现在进行时

statements.english: How do l tell her without crushing her ?
statements.chinese: 我该如何告诉她才能不让她伤心？

statements.english: Tell her she's not marriage material
statements.chinese: 告诉她，她不是结婚的料。

statements.english: What ?
statements.chinese: 什么？

statements.english: Girls say it to me all the time
statements.chinese: 女孩们经常这么对我说。

statements.english: And believe me , if she's anything like me
statements.chinese: 相信我，如果她和我有半点相似，

statements.english: she's just gonna be relieved
statements.chinese: 她只会感到如释重负。

statements.english: How do l tell Chandler that it's too soon ?
statements.chinese: 我该怎么告诉Chandler现在还为时过早？

statements.english: It's gonna break his heart
statements.chinese: 这会让他心碎的。

break.definition: 短语动词原型: 使心碎

statements.english: He's gonna think l don't love him anymore
statements.chinese: 他会以为我不再爱他了。

statements.english: - Well , you don't . - Yes , l do
statements.chinese: - 好吧，你并不需要。 - 不，我需要。

statements.english: Good , good . l was just testing you
statements.chinese: 很好，很好。我只是在考验你。

was.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去进行时

statements.english: You know what ? We were just talking about bacon
statements.chinese: 你知道吗？我们刚才还在讨论培根呢。

were.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去进行时

statements.chinese: 不，我们刚才在讨论网球。
